System diagnostics for cuplyr

Source: R/diagnostics.R
diagnostics.Rd

Collects comprehensive system information for debugging installation issues or filing bug reports. Includes cuplyr version, R/Rcpp versions, CUDA/cuDF paths, libcudf versions, GPU info, the GPU memory resource, the cuplyr options in effect and environment variables.

Usage

diagnostics(redact = TRUE, format = c("text", "json"))

Arguments

redact

If TRUE (default), redact potentially sensitive paths (home directory, usernames). Set to FALSE for local debugging.

format

"text" (default) prints a readable report. "json" prints one JSON object instead (and nothing else), for tools and scripts; its keys are the names of the returned list.

Value

Invisibly returns a list with all diagnostic information, whichever format is used. Also prints the report (or the JSON object) to the console. Besides the package, system, CUDA and GPU fields, the list has:

  • libcudf_version and rmm_version: the versions cuplyr was built against, as "26.10.2".

  • libcudf_path: the libcudf library loaded into this R session (NA if none), and libcudf_loaded_version, its version (NA when its headers can't be found). A difference from libcudf_version means cuplyr runs against another libcudf than it was built with. The printed report adds a WARNING line when either version is older than 26.02, the oldest libcudf cuplyr supports.

  • memory: a list with available, the memory resource ("async", "pool" or "cuda"), pool_bytes and pool_used_bytes. See gpu_memory_state().

  • options: a data frame with one row per cuplyr option, user and internal: option, value, default, source, env_var, internal and description. default is NA both for a default computed at run time (the initial pool size) and for no value at all (no release threshold); the text report says "computed" or "unset". See cuplyr_options().

A lookup that fails gives NA for its field; diagnostics() itself does not fail.

Details

The output includes:

  • Package versions: cuplyr, R, Rcpp, dplyr

  • CUDA info: toolkit version, driver version, CUDA_HOME path

  • libcudf info: CONDA_PREFIX, CUDF_HOME, the libcudf and RMM versions cuplyr was built against, the libcudf loaded and its version

  • GPU info: device name, compute capability, memory

  • GPU memory resource: the active resource and its pool size

  • Options: every cuplyr option with its value, source and default

  • Library paths: LD_LIBRARY_PATH, RPATH of cuplyr.so

  • Environment: OS, distro, key environment variables

See also

check_deps() for pre-install checks, verify_installation() for post-install verification, cuplyr_options() for the options

Examples

# Full diagnostics
diagnostics()
